display.purpose: Page titles; 2.75rem on the home hero.

shadows.name: float
shadows.purpose: Pet picker and sticky quiz submit bar only.

breakpoints.name: panel
breakpoints.purpose: Files panel moves beside the steps.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The next thing to press. One per view region.
components.css: .ds-btn { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; min-height: 40px; padding: 0 16px; font: 650 14px/1.2 'Figtree Variable', system-ui, sans-serif; color: #fff; background: #226929; border: 1px solid #226929; border-radius: 8px; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 150ms cubic-bezier(0.25,1,0.5,1); } .ds-btn:hover { background: #15561d; border-color: #15561d; }

components.name: Terminal Code Block
components.description: Every command students copy. The $ prompt is CSS and never copied.
components.css: .ds-code { background: #131a15; border-radius: 8px; overflow: hidden; } .ds-code-head { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center; padding: 4px 4px 4px 12px; border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.08); font: 13px 'JetBrains Mono Variable', monospace; color: #8c9e8f; } .ds-code-head button { font: 650 13px system-ui; color: #e3eae4; background: rgba(255,255,255,0.06); border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.12); border-radius: 6px; padding: 4px 12px; } .ds-code pre { margin: 0; padding: 12px 16px 16px; } .ds-code code { font: 14px/1.7 'JetBrains Mono Variable', monospace; color: #e3eae4; } .ds-line { display: block; } .ds-line::before { content: '$ '; color: #80cd82; user-select: none; }

components.name: You Are Here Tag
components.description: The single current item in a view.
components.css: .ds-here { display: inline-flex; font: 650 13px/1 'Figtree Variable', system-ui, sans-serif; padding: 5px 8px; border-radius: 6px; background: #fde75e; color: #272201; }

narrative.overview: A well-run university lab session: clean white bench paper, a chalkboard-green instructor's hand guiding each step, and a highlighter marking the one line that matters right now. The student's terminal is the real stage; this interface is the handout next to it.
keyCharacteristics: White bench, chalkboard-green actions, highlighter yellow only for 'you are here' and celebrations.
Near-black terminal code blocks with a green $ prompt that is never copied.
Flat by default; shadows only on floating things.

rules.name: The Highlighter Rule
rules.body: Yellow marks at most one current thing per view, plus celebrations.

rules.name: The Green Means Go Rule
rules.body: Green is for actions and completed progress; done states also carry a check or the word Done.

rules.name: The No Eyebrow Rule
rules.body: No small uppercase tracked labels above headings.

rules.name: The Flat Bench Rule
rules.body: If it doesn't float, it doesn't cast a shadow.

dos: Do keep commands the most legible thing on screen.
Do show where the student is at all times.
Do pair every status colour with an icon or a word.
Do write short, plain copy with no em-dashes.
donts: Don't make it look like a generic SaaS dashboard.
Don't make it look like a kids' learning app.
Don't use Docker's branding: no Docker blue, no whale or container-block marks.
Don't use yellow text on white.
